# Aurelith Forge — Free Fantasy RPG UI Starter Pack

A free / pay-what-you-want fantasy RPG inventory, shop and crafting UI starter pack for indie developers, game jam teams, UI artists and pitch deck creators.

Use it to quickly explore a warm parchment-and-gold RPG interface direction without starting from a blank page. The pack is built for prototypes, moodboards, pitch decks, layout studies and early visual direction.

## What’s included

- 12 high-resolution UI / layout / reference screens
- 60 RPG item icons as PNG 512x512
- 60 RPG item icons as PNG 256x256
- 60 SVG open-format icon alternatives
- 12 modular transparent PNG overlays
- 6 background panels / parchment / frame assets
- 3 ready-to-show mockup compositions
- JSON design tokens
- Local HTML/CSS preview page
- Documentation, license and AI disclosure

## Useful for

- Indie RPG prototypes
- Cozy fantasy game pitches
- Visual novel item/reward screens
- Game jam UI mockups
- Inventory, shop and crafting layout references
- Pitch deck visuals
- UI moodboarding and visual direction

## Why it is free

This is a free launch release from NexaVisuals. It is meant to help developers and designers start faster while also collecting early feedback for future packs.

Ratings, comments and donations are appreciated, but the pack can be downloaded for free.

## What this is not

**This is not a PSD, Figma, Unity, Unreal or Godot project.**

It is also not a fully coded engine-ready UI implementation. The pack is intended as a visual direction, reference and prototype asset bundle.

## Recommended workflow

1. Open the local HTML/CSS preview page.
2. Browse the UI screens and contact sheets.
3. Pick one target flow: inventory, shop, crafting, loot or rewards.
4. Combine screens, icons, overlays and panels in your design tool or engine prototype.
5. Replace or customize assets as your game art direction becomes more specific.

## Technical notes

- PNG preview and product assets are organized with readable filenames.
- SVG alternatives are included for icon open-format editing/reference.
- The preview page works locally and uses no external CDN.
- Text on cover and preview images was rendered cleanly during packaging rather than relying on generated lettering.

## License summary

You may use these assets in personal and commercial projects. You may modify them for your own games, prototypes, videos and pitch decks. You may not resell, redistribute or repackage the original files as another asset pack, dataset, template library or marketplace product.

## AI disclosure

This product contains AI-assisted digital graphics and AI-assisted production planning. Files were curated, organized, exported and packaged as a structured digital product. No third-party brands, logos, franchise characters or intentionally copied game styles are included.
